color.note: Two grounds, not light and dark modes. Sheet is the near-white page; Navy is the dark band used for the problem statement, the manifesto and the footer. Every token carries a value for both.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. The near-white sheet shared by hero options D and E; the navy value is the dark sections' ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and cards lifted off the page: legend sheets, dashboard tiles.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and table header rows — recessed, not lifted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text. 13.0:1 on surface, 12.6:1 on navy.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary text. 7.4:1 / 8.7:1.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels, readouts, axis ticks. 4.8:1 / 6.2:1 — still AA, never lighter than this.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between sections. Not for control edges — use border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The edge of anything interactive: inputs, outline buttons, chips. 4.0:1 / 5.0:1, clearing the 3:1 that control borders need.

tokens.name: contour
tokens.usage: Terrain contour lines. Background texture, never information.

tokens.name: contour-deep
tokens.usage: Higher-elevation contours, drawn a shade stronger.

tokens.name: map-signal
tokens.usage: The one lit ridge in a contour field. Map furniture only — never a button, label or tag.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Option D's accent, and the logo's. A FILL only on light grounds: as text it measures 2.3:1 and fails. On navy it reads 7.6:1 and may be text.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold pressed state, and gold hairlines on light grounds.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Option E's accent at mid strength: icon strokes, chart marks, check marks.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Green for display type on light grounds. 4.25:1 — passes for large text.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green at reading size, and the primary button's fill carrying surface-coloured text. 5.2:1 both directions.

tokens.name: green-pressed
tokens.usage: The primary button held down.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Vivid yellow, 100% saturation. Only ever a filled field with ink on it (8.2:1). As type or a hairline it is 1.5:1 and invisible.

tokens.name: yellow-deep
tokens.usage: The one weight of yellow that survives as a hairline. Eyebrow rules, 1px marks.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Good: within target, verified, trending up.

tokens.name: positive-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for a positive chip. Pair with positive-ink.

tokens.name: positive-ink
tokens.usage: Text on positive-surface. 7.0:1 / 5.3:1.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs attention. Always a filled chip — there is no dark yellow that stays yellow, so caution never becomes coloured text.

tokens.name: caution-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for a caution chip.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: Text on caution-surface. 8.2:1 both themes.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Breached, failed, overdue.

tokens.name: critical-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for a critical chip.

tokens.name: critical-ink
tokens.usage: Text on critical-surface. 7.6:1 / 8.1:1.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First chart series. The ramp climbs in lightness so the series stay apart in greyscale and for colour-blind readers, not by hue alone.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series. The lightest step: good for bars and area fills, too pale on light grounds for a hairline.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero headline. Set uppercase. Ships as clamp(2rem, 4.2vw, 3.6rem); the figure here is the desktop maximum. Add font-variation-settings: "wght" 700, "GRAD" 120.

styles.name: manifesto
styles.usage: Long uppercase statements set over several lines. GRAD 40 — the grade drops because a full paragraph of caps reads heavier than a headline.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Dashboard figures and stat tiles. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits align in a column. GRAD 120.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline. clamp(1.02rem, 1.25vw, 1.15rem). Keep to about 34em.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels, uppercase. Needs font-variation-settings: "wdth" 76 — the condensed width is what makes small type read as a map label rather than UI chrome.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Coordinates, timestamps, axis ticks. wdth 70 — the narrowest width in the system.

styles.name: key-label
styles.usage: Legend keys and status chips, uppercase. wdth 78.

spacing.note: A 4px grid, with two gutter values taken from the live site rather than rounded to the grid.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and keys.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding-block; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button padding-inline; gaps between tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, and the gap between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a headline and the block under it.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding, mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding, desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Page gutter below 768px. Not on the 4px grid — it is the measured value the site ships.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width for running text, about 65 characters.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Content column maximum.

radius.note: The system is squared off. Zero radius is an identity trait, not an oversight: this is a survey sheet, and printed sheets have corners.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, panels, inputs, chips, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The only exception — chart point markers and status dots, where a square reads as a glitch.

shadow.note: One shadow, used sparingly. Depth comes from hairlines and ground changes, not from lift.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels only — menus, poppers. Never on a static card.
